title: 2222. Printing the Squares of the First N Natural Numbers
description:
Submissions
2222
. 
Printing the Squares of the First N Natural Numbers
20
Easy
Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print the squares of the numbers from 1 to N, using a for loop.
Description
Read an integer N from input. Use a for loop that runs from 1 to N, and on each iteration print the square of the loop counter (the counter multiplied by itself). Print all the squares on one line, separated by single spaces.
Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
Output Description
Print the squares of 1 to N, separated by single spaces, on one line.
Sample Input
5
Sample Output
1 4 9 16 25
